seo.title: Veterinary Research Institute of Angola
seo.description: Scientific research, laboratory diagnostics and vaccine production serving animal health and food safety in Angola.

editorial.title: Researching to protect Angola's animal health.
editorial.lead: The Veterinary Research Institute is the public institution responsible for scientific research, vaccine production and laboratory diagnostics serving livestock farming and national public health.
editorial.body: Since 1965, the IIV has supported the development of the agricultural and livestock sector in every province of the country, with an integrated network of laboratories, regional stations and partnerships with leading international organisations.

items.title: Laboratory Diagnostics
items.desc: Comprehensive analyses in virology, bacteriology and animal pathology.

items.title: Vaccine Production
items.desc: Manufacture of veterinary immunobiologicals to international standards.

items.title: Scientific Research
items.desc: Applied research into animal health and food safety.

items.title: Technical Training
items.desc: Capacity-building for Angola's national veterinary workforce.

manifesto.quote: “Our mission is to generate scientific knowledge that protects livestock, strengthens the rural economy and ensures safe food for all Angolans.”
manifesto.author: IIV Board of Directors
